purpose: Reviewer requested interaction-effect analysis between runtime components. This framework executes the FULL L-DREA runtime under every requested combination and MEASURES the result; no value is analytically estimated; the frozen Gamma engine is unmodified.

component_registry.discovery_method: importlib + inspect probing of live runtime symbols; a component is listed only if its symbol resolves. Dependencies inferred from (1) call order in run_runtime_stack.main and (2) signature-token scanning of each component's own source.

components.name: Predicate Engine
components.role: generates the runtime predicate vector Gamma aggregates non-compensatorily

components.name: Runtime Revocation
components.role: issues Permit-to-Act tokens and withdraws already-granted authority

components.name: Evidence Quad
components.role: emits the signed ERTuple (method/policy/ledger/replay evidence) per decision

components.name: Runtime Ledger
components.role: chains evidence into an append-only Merkle-rooted ledger

components.name: Hash Chain
components.role: links each ledger block to its predecessor (tamper-evident ordering)

components.name: Runtime Risk Detection
components.role: fires real adversarial artifacts at the enforcement surface and measures refusal

components.name: Runtime Watchdog
components.role: supervisor thread detecting per-worker stalls and driving fail-closed recovery

components.name: Fleet Telemetry
components.role: multi-process Gamma fleet with per-worker CPU/RSS/throughput telemetry

undetected_risk_rate.population: label-positive (fraud/attack) items of the BLIND stream
undetected_risk_rate.means: fraction of withheld-label positives the runtime PERMITTED, under unsupervised anomaly-bound predicates
undetected_risk_rate.NOT_the_same_as: the paper's False Permit Rate (Table 12: 0/492 = 0.000; Table 18: 0/62 = 0.000), which is AUTHORIZATION SOUNDNESS -- permitting an action the authorization oracle says DENY. That metric is ZERO and is not measured, changed or contradicted by this experiment.

benign_flag_rate.population: label-negative (legitimate) items of the BLIND stream
benign_flag_rate.means: fraction of legitimate items the runtime DENIED (a detection false alarm)
benign_flag_rate.NOT_the_same_as: the paper's False Denial Rate (Table 12: 0/284,315 = 0.000), which is denial of an action the authorization oracle says PERMIT.

blind_risk_detection_recall.means: recall of the blind unsupervised anomaly-bound predicates on the stream
blind_risk_detection_recall.NOT_the_same_as: the paper's 'Runtime Risk Detection' (Tables 15/18: 2394/2394 = 1.000), which is the refusal rate of INJECTED ATTACKS against the enforcement surface (runtime_attacks.py) -- a different experiment.

blind_decision_accuracy.means: agreement of the runtime decision with the WITHHELD FRAUD LABEL
blind_decision_accuracy.NOT_the_same_as: authorization conformance against the golden-oracle trace (E1)

runtime_integrity_score.formula: mean of six health planes, normalized so the intact stack = 1.000
runtime_integrity_score.means: composite introduced by THIS experiment (E5b); appears in no other paper table

metric_definitions.baseline_URR_is_not_a_defect: The baseline undetected_risk_rate is > 0 BY CONSTRUCTION: ~40% of synthetic positives are stealthy and observably identical to negatives (run_runtime_stack.synth_stream). It characterises the GENERATOR and the blind predicate floor -- NOT an authorization failure. The paper's zero-event authorization claim is untouched by it.

runtime_integrity_score_definition: mean of six [0,1] health indicators normalized so the intact baseline scores 1.0 (authz recall/baseline, revocation, evidence, ledger, hash-chain, replay). Four of six planes are audit/provenance, so RIS is audit-weighted by construction; the security axis is also reported separately.

governance.note: fleet/telemetry honor PE and RV ablation (PE-off eliminates predicate work → lower busy fraction; RV-off stops revocation enforcement → revoked permits execute); EQ/LG/HC do not touch the fleet worker path so their fleet numbers are config-invariant. Watchdog stall-DETECTION is timing-sensitive in a small per-config fleet (the saturation-guarded detector only fires when the queue stays deep during the stall); the authoritative 6-scenario watchdog proof is E11b watchdog_scenarios_report.json. Governance is EXCLUDED from the interaction analysis because it is orthogonal to the decision-path toggles.

ptp_offset_single_host.why_not_ptp: PTP synchronises clocks across separate physical hosts against a grandmaster. On a single machine there is exactly one system clock, so there is nothing to synchronise. Distributed clock skew and PTP bounds require >=2 hosts and a PTP grandmaster; see FINAL_GAP_ANALYSIS.md.

interactions.why: Planes: EQ (evidence plane); HC (ledger plane); PE (authorization plane); LG (ledger plane); RV (enforcement plane). Dependency within the set: HC depends on LG, HC depends on EQ, LG depends on EQ. The single removals predict a degradation exceeding the whole stack (additive > baseline 1.0), but integrity floors at 0 — the combination is saturated, not mutually redundant on independent planes.

Planes: EQ (evidence plane); PE (authorization plane); RV (enforcement plane). The single removals predict a degradation exceeding the whole stack (additive > baseline 1.0), but integrity floors at 0 — the combination is saturated, not mutually redundant on independent planes.

Planes: EQ (evidence plane); PE (authorization plane). The components act on independent planes (authorization, evidence); neither masks the other, so the composite degradation is the sum of the parts.
Planes: EQ (evidence plane); RV (enforcement plane). The components act on independent planes (enforcement, evidence); neither masks the other, so the composite degradation is the sum of the parts.

Planes: EQ (evidence plane); HC (ledger plane). Dependency within the set: HC depends on EQ. The upstream component is a prerequisite of the downstream one, so the downstream integrity was already destroyed by the upstream removal alone — the combined effect equals the upstream single effect, not their sum.

Planes: EQ (evidence plane); HC (ledger plane); LG (ledger plane). Dependency within the set: HC depends on LG, HC depends on EQ, LG depends on EQ. The upstream component is a prerequisite of the downstream one, so the downstream integrity was already destroyed by the upstream removal alone — the combined effect equals the upstream single effect, not their sum.

The upstream component is a prerequisite of the downstream one, so the downstream integrity was already destroyed by the upstream removal alone — the combined effect equals the upstream single effect, not their sum.
Planes: PE (authorization plane); LG (ledger plane). The components act on independent planes (authorization, ledger); neither masks the other, so the composite degradation is the sum of the parts.
Planes: LG (ledger plane); RV (enforcement plane). The components act on independent planes (enforcement, ledger); neither masks the other, so the composite degradation is the sum of the parts.
Planes: HC (ledger plane); PE (authorization plane). The components act on independent planes (authorization, ledger); neither masks the other, so the composite degradation is the sum of the parts.

On a single machine there is exactly one system clock, so there is nothing to synchronise. Distributed clock skew and PTP bounds require >=2 hosts and a PTP grandmaster; see FINAL_GAP_ANALYSIS.md.
